name: Black Lady
summary: Trick-avoidance card game where players try to avoid taking hearts and the queen of spades.
rules_text: Played with a 52-card deck, 3-6 players (4 best). If player count does not divide 52 evenly, remove low clubs/diamonds to equalize hands. Deal all cards clockwise. Each deal, each player passes three cards face-down to the left neighbor without seeing incoming cards. Eldest hand leads any card. Follow suit if possible; otherwise discard any card. No trumps. Highest card of led suit wins trick and leads next. After all tricks, each heart taken scores 1 penalty, queen of spades scores 13. If one player takes all 26 penalty points (shooting the moon), they score 0 and all opponents score 26. Otherwise scores accumulate. Game ends when a player reaches 100 points; lowest total wins.
